description: Internal Spark functions used in Pandas API on Spark & PySpark Native Plotting, including utility methods for column operations, statistical functions, and vector manipulations.

classes.name: InternalFunction
classes.description: A class providing static methods for internal Spark functions used in Pandas API on Spark and PySpark native plotting, including statistical and vector operations.

methods.name: _invoke_internal_function_over_columns
methods.description: Invokes an internal Spark function over given columns, handling remote and local contexts.

methods.name: timestamp_ntz_to_long
methods.description: Converts a timestamp with no time zone to a long integer.

methods.name: product
methods.description: Calculates the product of a column, with an option to drop NA values.

methods.name: stddev
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation of a column with a specified degrees of freedom.

methods.name: var
methods.description: Calculates the variance of a column with a specified degrees of freedom.

methods.name: skew
methods.description: Calculates the skewness of a column.

methods.name: kurt
methods.description: Calculates the kurtosis of a column.

methods.name: mode
methods.description: Calculates the mode of a column, with an option to drop NA values.

methods.name: covar
methods.description: Calculates the covariance between two columns with a specified degrees of freedom.

methods.name: ewm
methods.description: Calculates exponentially weighted moments for a column.

methods.name: null_index
methods.description: Returns the index of null values in a column.

methods.name: distributed_sequence_id
methods.description: Returns a distributed sequence ID column.

methods.name: collect_top_k
methods.description: Collects top K elements from a column, with order specified.

methods.name: array_binary_search
methods.description: Performs binary search on an array column for a value.

methods.name: make_interval
methods.description: Creates an interval column based on unit and value.

methods.name: vector_get
methods.description: Retrieves an element from a vector column at a specified index.

methods.name: array_argmax
methods.description: Finds the index of the maximum value in an array, ignoring NaN and nulls.
